eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Otero, NM; at 4:25 PM on AUG 29, 2025 Effective until 9:25 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: High winds coming from the north are causing blowing dust and dangerously low visibility across Otero County and surrounding areas, especially along U.S. Highway 70 and U.S. Highway 54. Sudden drops in visibility can occur without warning — if you cannot see, Pull Over and Wait.
